verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中，一心称谢耶和华。
verses.en: Praise the Lord!I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart,in the assembly of the godly and the congregation.

verses.zh: 耶和华的作为本为大；凡喜爱的都必考察。
verses.en: The Lord’s deeds are great,eagerly awaited[NOTE:1] by all who desire them.
notes: Psalm 111. The psalmist praises God for his marvelous deeds, especially the way in which he provides for and delivers his people. The psalm is an acrostic. After the introductory call to praise, every poetic line (twenty-two in all) begins with a successive letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

verses.zh: 他所行的是尊荣和威严；他的公义存到永远。
verses.en: His work is majestic and glorious,[NOTE:1] and his faithfulness endures[NOTE:2] forever.
notes: For other uses of the Hebrew phrase וְהָדָרהוֹד (hod vehadar, “majesty and splendor”) see 1 Chr 16:27; Job 40:10; Pss 21:5; 96:6; 104:1.

verses.zh: 他行了奇事，使人记念；耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。
verses.en: He does[NOTE:1] amazing things that will be remembered;[NOTE:2] the Lord is merciful and compassionate.
notes: Or “did,” if this refers primarily to the events of the exodus and conquest period (see vv. 6, 9).

verses.zh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人；他必永远记念他的约。
verses.en: He gives[NOTE:1] food to his faithful followers;[NOTE:2] he always remembers his covenant.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “a memorial he had made for his amazing deeds.”
Or “gave,” if the events of the exodus and conquest period (see v. 6, 9) are primarily in view.

verses.zh: 他向百姓显出大能的作为，把外邦的地赐给他们为业。
verses.en: He announced that he would do mighty deeds for his people,giving them a land that belonged to other nations.[NOTE:1]
notes: Or “he remembers his covenant forever” (see Ps 105:8).

verses.zh: 他手所行的是诚实公平；他的训词都是确实的，
verses.en: His acts are characterized by[NOTE:1] faithfulness and justice;all his precepts are reliable.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “the strength of his deeds he proclaimed to his people, to give to them an inheritance of nations.”

verses.zh: 是永永远远坚定的，是按诚实正直设立的。
verses.en: They are forever firmand should be faithfully and properly carried out.[NOTE:1]
notes: That is, fair and for man’s good.

verses.zh: 他向百姓施行救赎，命定他的约，直到永远；他的名圣而可畏。
verses.en: He delivered his people;[NOTE:1] he ordained that his covenant be observed forever.[NOTE:2] His name is holy and awesome.
notes: Heb “done in faithfulness and uprightness.” The passive participle probably has the force of a gerund. See L. C. Allen, Psalms 101-150 (WBC), 89.
Heb “redemption he sent for his people.”

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端；凡遵行他命令的是聪明人。耶和华是永远当赞美的！
verses.en: To obey the Lord is the fundamental principle for wise living;[NOTE:1] all who carry out his precepts acquire good moral insight.[NOTE:2] He will receive praise forever.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “the beginning of wisdom [is] the fear of the Lord.”

Heb “good sense [is] to all who do them.” The third masculine plural pronominal suffix must refer back to the “precepts” mentioned in v. 7. In the translation the referent has been specified for clarity. The phrase שֵׂכֶל טוֹב (sekhel tov) also occurs in Prov 3:4; 13:15 and 2 Chr 30:22.
